role: Independent W034 review sub-agent; fresh Codex round after Opus API failure with no mathematical findings.

frozen_local_inputs.semantic_read_scope: Lines 1-80 in full; all heading lines; search for W034 (no matching line at freeze). Full file copied and hashed as provenance, not semantically read in full.

filename_discovery.command: rg --files with globs for AGENTS.md, RESEARCH_TEAM.md, RESEARCH_LOOP.md, README.md, SPECIFICATION.md, W034*, W020-collision-extraction-review.md, W001-orders.md, W001-baselines.md
filename_discovery.scope: Project-wide filename inventory only on initial discovery. It exposed names of archived/frozen documents, including W032 evidence paths, but none of those evidence contents was read. Subsequent content reads used the exact ten-file input list.

read_order: Five root guidance/specification documents and live W034 read entirely first; ten local inputs byte-frozen next. W020 and both W001 reports then read from frozen copies. Long combined output truncated the W001 portions, so both W001 reports were re-read separately in full. STATE limited as recorded above. W034 frozen copy re-read at final review.
owned_artifact_reads: All authored review/evidence files read or parsed for integrity. Source download inspection is detailed in the source ledger; retired downloads have hashes recorded there.
excluded_content: W032 reports and massive evidence directories (except incidental W032 descriptions already inside the mandatory input documents and STATE excerpt)
permitted_work_performed: local document copying and SHA256 provenance
not_performed: enumeration of sampled moduli or bases
verification_scope: Delivery integrity is a document/provenance check, not mathematical formalization or an empirical success-rate test.
